bootstrapImport.title: Import your cases
bootstrapImport.denied: You need permission to add matters to import files.

empty.title: Bring your existing cases in
empty.body: Drop cause lists, orders and diary photos. CauseDeck finds only the cases that carry your enrolment number or name, builds a plan you review, and nothing is created until you confirm.

channel.title: Turn on bulk import first
channel.body: Bulk import is off until a workspace manager turns it on. Files are kept in India, are not used to train models and raw files are deleted after 30 days.
channel.ownerOnly: Ask a workspace owner to turn it on.
channel.failed: Bulk import could not be turned on. Try again.

bootstrapImport.sensitive: Matters marked sensitive are never imported, and files hinted at one are refused.

drop.label: Drop files or a folder here
drop.hint: Up to {max} files: PDF, images, Word, calendar (.ics) and text.
drop.refused: Only {max} files can be imported at a time. {n, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} not added.
drop.offline: You are offline. Files can be added when you are back online.

list.title: Files
list.summary: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} of {max}

reason.type: This file type is not accepted.
reason.size: This file is over the size limit for its type.
reason.sensitive: This file belongs to a sensitive matter.
reason.too_large: This file is over the size limit.
reason.unsupported: This file type is not accepted.
reason.rate_limited: Too many uploads. Try again in a minute.

identifiers.title: Which cases are yours?
identifiers.body: Only cases that carry your enrolment number or a spelling of your name are imported. Nothing is read until you give at least one.
identifiers.confirmBody: These are used to pick your cases from every list you import.

processing.title: Reading your files
processing.failed: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} could not be read.
processing.nothing: Nothing recognised. None of the files had a case with your enrolment number or name.
processing.ready: Your plan is ready. {n, plural, one {# row matches} other {# rows match}} you.
processing.kept: Import limit reached for this plan. {n, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} kept as attachments without reading.
